name: G. E. Morrow
role: University of Illinois professor, cattle-feeding experiments
mentions: After some protracted experiments in cattle feeding at the Illinois State university, Prof. G. E. Morrow says: Bearing in mind that it is not wise to draw final conclusions from single trials, the fact concerning these cattle suggest or illustrate, among other things, that:…
Cattle Feeding on a College Farm.
…of best form is a pure bred Short-Horn, but a local trouble has reduced his weight 200 pounds or more.  G. E. MORROW, Prof. of Agriculture. University, Champaign, Ill.
